suppliers.approved_statement:
Set wedge^N V_aff=V_aff^tensorN/Ker A_N, with u_(m1)∧…∧u_(mN) its images. Fix normal order m1>…>mN. The quotient is U_q-stable for the fixed coproduct. For l<m write m−l=a e+b, a≥0, 0≤b<e. The exact local relations are: u_l∧u_l=0; u_l∧u_m=−u_m∧u_l if b=0; u_l∧u_m=−q^-1 u_m∧u_l if a=0,b>0; and if a>0,b>0,
u_l∧u_m=−q^-1u_m∧u_l−u_(l+ae)∧u_(m−ae)−q^-1u_(m−ae)∧u_(l+ae).
Repeat this same recurrence on its remaining unordered pair; the gap drops by e in that branch. All correction indices are strictly between l,m, with the same sum and residue multiset. The integral lattice W_A is the image of the Laurent tensor lattice and equals the A-span of the normal basis after the next theorem. The zero chart W0 is separately its A0 normal-basis span; W_A/qW_A is0 and is not a crystal residue. The numerical energy criterion uses H_op from the explicitly OP channel; H_op>0 is equivalent to normal decreasing indices, not a claim about our tensor crystal projector.
suppliers.approved_strategy: Use S=−q t and Leclerc Proposition8. Its full two-factor Bernstein computation gives the displayed three cases, not a truncated sum with constant coefficients. For a>0,b>0, (l+ae,m−ae)=(m−b,l+b) is already decreasing; the third pair is its reverse and has gap ae−b=(a−1)e+(e−b), so repeated application is finite. Equal residues follow from the symmetric loop-shift action on the diagonal kernel; repeated entries vanish. All relations lie in Ker(S+1) and the kernel/gap induction gives generation. U-stability follows from the checked Hecke intertwiners. The later normalized-R bridge proves the exact braiding kernel; it does not replace this finite computation. Integral coefficients are Laurent integers, and positive/infinity crystal charts require separate rings.

suppliers.approved_statement: For the displayed H_N(q²) action let C_N=Σ_w q^(2 length(w))=Π_(r=1)^N(1+q²+…+q^(2(r−1))). Then A_N²=C_N A_N and Ker A_N=Σ_i Ker(S_i+1). The field quotient by this kernel is Im A_N. The two-factor kernel is the partial q-symmetric subspace, generated by its explicit loop-shifted U-orbits; its quotient relations are the FULL three-case straightening recurrence in the next Definition. At q=1 these are ordinary antisymmetry. No torsionfree-over-A argument or A0 quotient of Laurent A is used.
suppliers.approved_strategy: Factor A_N on both sides by(1+S_i) using paired Coxeter lengths. Hence S_i A_N=A_N S_i=Q A_N, so A_N²=C_N A_N. Let J=ΣKer(S_i+1); the paired-length factorization gives J⊂Ker A_N. For every x, (S_i−Q)x lies in Ker(S_i+1) because(S_i+1)(S_i−Q)=0. Thus modulo J, x S_w≡Q^length(w)x and x A_N≡C_N x. If A_N x=0 this gives C_N x∈J; C_N≠0 in the generic field proves x∈J. It also proves the splitting/idempotent quotient. For two factors compute S on the three residue cases and the complete l∈Z Bernstein recurrence: equal residues yield symmetric loop relations; unequal residues yield the base adjacent residue relation and its symmetric-loop shifts, whose gap induction is exactly the following three-case recurrence. This establishes the kernel on the ORIGINAL Laurent-loop vector space, not only a localization.
